text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Business Names Registration (Application to Legal Profession) Regulations 2015.

2.—(1) Section 4(1)(c) of the Act does not apply to —
(a)an individual who is a sole proprietor of —
(i)a law firm; or
(ii)a foreign law practice that provides any legal services in Singapore; or
(b)a firm of 2 or more individuals which is —
(i)a law firm;
(ii)a foreign law practice that provides any legal services in Singapore; or
(iii)a Joint Law Venture.
(2) In paragraph (1), “foreign law practice”, “Joint Law Venture” and “law firm” have the meanings given by section 2(1) of the Legal Profession Act 1966.
